limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the write increment but also changed when Gray pointers reach the synchronizers, registered the full and empty flags, and gated RAM enables with reset, altering timing and handshakes that the one-line fix preserves.

The scoreboard used the DUT's own flags to decide when transfers occurred and checked flag values after settling, so it could pass without detecting cycle-by-cycle changes in flag timing and transfer acceptance.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The rejected cleanup command forced the test invocation to be resubmitted, and the subsequent failed Git check required a separate whitespace check that also repeated the successful compile.
